decision.summaryForCoordinator: v8 remasures occupancy of the already-named G15 identifier at live HEAD 1db4eda with required-now 28 and file 08 f909ddff, and every externally checkable claim it makes is true on live bytes. All 34 cited digests recomputed and matched; recordedInputs.HEAD equals the top-level head and live rev-parse; all six verbatim quotes are byte-exact and column-correct against file-08 line 351. The closed map is set-equal to v14's 80 members in both directions, all 70 claimed-rideless keys carry ride null in v14, all 9 rided keys carry producer 'none' with character-exact ride strings, and the 48-key producer partition matches v14 key-by-key with zero mismatches. All three cells carry all 80 keys. The three leftover-joins were parsed independently and v8 reproduces each leftoverDesign set exactly without flipping or stealing any: [OBL-AT-FX-AUTHORING] on G15, [OBL-ADAPTER-IMPL, OBL-AT-FX-AUTHORING] on DR-120, and the five DR-103 leftovers. All six prior findings CLAUDE-G15H-V1-SF1 through V6-SF1 were re-verified against live bytes rather than carried forward on the subject's account; all are landed and none regressed, including the V6 repair, which is corroborated independently by v14 carrying no D-106 or corpus producer anywhere in its 80 members. v7 is correctly held frozen and excluded as current, and that exclusion was confirmed from v7's own bytes (head 5d5d778, required-now 26, file08 3a9442d1) rather than accepted on assertion. No SATISFIED, no Class A, no QUALIFIED, no Rust minting, no fixture bytes, no adapter implementation, no implementation-directory authorization. Four observations are recorded without charge, the only substantive one being a prose-glossed activeClasses entry in the upgrade cell that displaces no map key and stands unchanged from the ACCEPTed v7.
